Order top row: hunting-shrines-village-paving-stairs-up, hunting-shrines-village-paving-stairs-down, hunting-zockau-mid-century-street-pavement-stairs-up; bottom row: hunting-zockau-mid-century-street-pavement-stairs-down, industry-menagerie-industrial-brick-stairs-up, industry-menagerie-industrial-brick-stairs-down. Source/contact rows are in this same order. Far-right rear references are accepted same-role geometry guides only. Rear view is the opaque reverse support wall behind the stair flight, no visible upper treads, no upward camera, no front stair face. Keep full support height and the source-appropriate paving stone, old cobble, or brick identity. Preserve support edges/rail posts from each Ink source. Each cell one centered complete object, transparent gutters, no crop/overlap/object swaps/text. Inferred, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.
bottom_prompt: Create exactly six transparent orthographic BOTTOM views in a 3-column by 2-row atlas in the same object order. Source/contact rows are in that order; far-right bottom views are accepted same-role geometry guides only. From directly underneath, show a complete opaque flat substrate covering the same full square/rectangular XY footprint as each accepted TOP, with stone/brick/earth support material matching that Ink source. Do not show upper treads or upper paving faces through opaque material. No unrelated trays, no missing corners, no trapezoid depth. Center one object per cell with transparent gutters; no cropping/text/object swaps. Inferred hidden surfaces, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.
